issues.description: Type inconsistency for attribute numberOfLecturers: the problem statement/UML specifies numberOfLecturers as int, but the reference solution declares the field as byte. This also propagates into the API via a constructor parameter of type byte and a setter parameter of type byte, which can confuse students and conflict with expected signatures if tests follow the UML.
issues.suggestedFix: Make numberOfLecturers consistently int as in the UML: change the field type to int and update the constructor and setter parameter types accordingly (and keep getter/setter signatures consistent). Alternatively, if byte is intended, update the UML/problem statement (and tests) to specify byte.
